question.problem: Due to a quarantine initiated in March $2020$, the number of reservations per night in a hotel decreased by one-quarter each month. By the end of $2020,$ the number of reservations per night decreased to $75\cdot {(\frac{3}{4})}^{9}.$ What does the factor $75$ mean in this context?

choices.value: The number of reservations per night decreased by $75$ each year
There were $75$ reservations per night $9$ months after March $2020$
The number of reservations per night increased by $75$ each year
There were $75$ reservations per night initially
There were $75$ reservations per night each month in $2020$

current_example.problem: A house was purchased for $\[math]90\,000.$ Shortly after purchasing the property, the owners discovered widening cracks in the foundation. As a result, the value of the property is reduced by one-half every year. What does the expression $\[/math]\,90\,000\left(\dfrac{1}{2}\right)^6$ mean in this context?
current_example.worked_solution:
The given expression is an exponential decay expression of the form $y(t) = a \cdot b^t,$ where we have the following:

- $a=90\,000$ represents the purchase price of the property.

- $b = \dfrac 1 2$ is the decay factor.

- $t = 6$ the time, in years, since the property was bought.

Since $t=6,$ the expression $\[math]\,90\,000\left(\dfrac{1}{2}\right)^6$ gives the value of the property after $6$ years.
